entries.def:
θέρος, -ους, τό
(θέρω, to heat), [in LXX chiefly for קַיִץ ;] 
summer: Mat.24.32, Mrk.13.28, Luk.21.30.†
(AS)

θεσσαλονίκη, -ης, ἡ 
Thessalonica, a city of Macedonia: Act.17.1, 11; 17.13, Php.4.16, 2Ti.4.10.†
(AS)

Θευδᾶς
(perh. contr. from Θεόδωρος, but see MM, Exp., xv), -ᾶ, ὁ 
Theudas: Act.5.36.†
(AS)

θεωρία, -ας, ἡ
(see: θεωρέω), [in LXX: Dan LXX 5:7, 2Ma.5.26 2Mac.15.12, 3Ma.5.24 * ;] 
__1. a viewing. 
__2. = θεώρημα, a spectacle, sight: Luk.23.48 (both senses in cl.).†
(AS)

Θήκη, -ης, ἡ
(τίθημι), [in LXX: Exo.25.27 (בַּיִת), Isa.6.13; 3.26 * ;] 
a receptacle, chest, case: of the sheath of a sword, Jhn.18.11.†
(AS)

θηλάζω
(θηλή, a breast), [in LXX chiefly for יָנַק hi. ;] 
__1. of the mother, to suckle: Mat.24.19, Mrk.13.17, Luk.21.23. 
__2. Of the young, to suck: Mat.21.16 μαστούς, Luk.11.27 (cf. Job.3.12, Sng.8.1, al.).†
(AS)

θῆλυς, -εια, -υ 
[in LXX chiefly for נְקֵבָה ;] 
female: as subst., ἡ θ., a female, a woman: Rom.1.26-27; τὸ θ.., Mat.19.4, Mrk.10.6, Gal.3.28.†
(AS)

θήρα, -ας, ἡ 
[in LXX for צַיִד, טָרַף, רֶשֶׁת, and cogn. forms ;] 
__1. a hunting, chase (Hat., Xen., al.). 
__2. prey, game (c1.). 
__3. As in Psa.35.8 = רֶשֶׁת, a net: Rom.11.9 (but see Thayer, see word).†
(AS)
